_note: Original hook formulas for boost-studio. Kurdish examples are drafts and need a native speaker's review.

formulas.name: Direct need
formulas.pattern: Name the exact thing the viewer wants right now.

formulas.name: Before / after
formulas.pattern: Show the painful before, then the fix, in one line.
formulas.ku_example: پێشتر چەند ڕۆژ چاوەڕێ دەبووی، ئێستا بە یەک پەیام.

formulas.name: Mistake
formulas.pattern: One mistake people make when buying/booking X.
formulas.ku_example: ئەم هەڵەیە مەکە کاتێک شتێک دەکڕیت.

formulas.name: Number list
formulas.pattern: N things to check before X (only real, checkable items).

formulas.name: Question from the DMs
formulas.pattern: Answer the question customers really ask.

formulas.name: Behind the counter
formulas.pattern: Show what happens in the shop/studio nobody sees.
formulas.ku_example: ئەوەی لە دووکانەکە ڕوودەدات پێش ئەوەی ئۆردەر بنێریت.

formulas.name: Myth bust
formulas.pattern: State a common belief, then correct it.

formulas.name: Timer
formulas.pattern: Do X in N seconds (must be true on screen).

formulas.name: Compare
formulas.pattern: Two options side by side, one verdict.

formulas.name: Local pride
formulas.pattern: Anchor in the place the audience lives.

formulas.name: Show the result first
formulas.pattern: Start on the finished result, then explain.

formulas.name: Direct invitation
formulas.pattern: One clear action in the first line.
